ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_001.source_old: I will inform our superiors about the capture of the Troll leader. Keep a close watch on the prisoners, commander, as there is no telling what vile schemes they are already hatching.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_001.source_new: I will inform our superiors about the capture of the Troll leader. Keep a close watch on the prisoners, commander, as there is no telling what vile schemes they are already hatching.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_002.source_old: Don’t worry, my men know a thing or two about handling outlaws.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_002.source_new: Don’t worry, my men know a thing or two about handling outlaws.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_003.source_old: Do not underestimate the Forest Trolls, for they are unlike anything your men have ever faced. I will leave you a dozen of my archers.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S001_003.source_new: Do not underestimate the Forest Trolls, for they are unlike anything your men have ever faced. I will leave you a dozen of my archers.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_001.source_old: Our scouts have confirmed that a band of human soldiers have captured a war party led by troll commander Zul’jin, and have taken them to a secret prison near the outskirts of Durnholde Keep.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_001.source_new: Our scouts have confirmed that a band of human soldiers have captured a war party led by troll commander Zul’jin, and have taken them to a secret prison near the outskirts of Durnholde Keep.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_002.source_old: Seeing an opportunity to place these captives in debt to the Horde, Doomhammer has commanded that we focus our efforts on liberating Zul’jin and his trolls. Once freed from the clutches of their human captors, we are to return them to the safety of their own encampment nearby.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_002.source_new: Seeing an opportunity to place these captives in debt to the Horde, Doomhammer has commanded that we focus our efforts on liberating Zul’jin and his trolls. Once freed from the clutches of their human captors, we are to return them to the safety of their own encampment nearby.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_003.source_old: This raid upon the unsuspecting prison will strike terror into the hearts of those who would dare resist the Horde!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S002_003.source_new: This raid upon the unsuspecting prison will strike terror into the hearts of those who would dare resist the Horde!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_001.source_old: Hmm...Forest Trolls, how convenient. Let us approach with caution.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_001.source_new: Hmm...Forest Trolls, how convenient. Let us approach with caution.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_002.source_old: Greetings, Amani, we have been dispatched by our Warchief to rescue your legendary leader. Were you part of Zul'jin's war-party?
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_002.source_new: Greetings, Amani, we have been dispatched by our Warchief to rescue your legendary leader. Were you part of Zul'jin's war-party?

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_003.source_old: Amani... we've not been called by dat name for generations, not since the days of our great empire of old. You be well versed in our history, stranger.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_003.source_new: Amani... we've not been called by dat name for generations, not since the days of our great empire of old. You be well versed in our history, stranger.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_004.source_old: We were indeed led by the great Zul'jin, until we be ambushed by da Humans. Three of us were killed, and da rest were captured. I managed to evade capture so I could warn my brethren of Zul'jin's abduction.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_004.source_new: We were indeed led by the great Zul'jin, until we be ambushed by da Humans. Three of us were killed, and da rest were captured. I managed to evade capture so I could warn my brethren of Zul'jin's abduction.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_005.source_old: Their camp be on da other side of da forest, but da path be blocked by dat accursed human settlement.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_005.source_new: Their camp be on da other side of da forest, but da path be blocked by dat accursed human settlement.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_006.source_old: We cannot make it there on our own, but if ya truly be here to help us, den we will show you how to build a proper Troll Lumber Mill and grant you the use of our tools and weapons!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_006.source_new: We cannot make it there on our own, but if ya truly be here to help us, den we will show you how to build a proper Troll Lumber Mill and grant you the use of our tools and weapons!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_007.source_old: Zul'jin is of great interest to our Warchief. That is why we are here to slaughter his captors and deliver him to safety. We will aid you in your plight, Amani.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_007.source_new: Zul'jin is of great interest to our Warchief. That is why we are here to slaughter his captors and deliver him to safety. We will aid you in your plight, Amani.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_008.source_old: Our axes are yours to command, Orc Master.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S003_008.source_new: Our axes are yours to command, Orc Master.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S004_001.source_old: Hmm... a patrol. Their camp must be nearby.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S004_001.source_new: Hmm... a patrol. Their camp must be nearby.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_001.source_old: Chieftain, I know our focus must be Zul’jin, but burning this place to the ground would greatly weaken Durnholde.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_001.source_new: Chieftain, I know our focus must be Zul’jin, but burning this place to the ground would greatly weaken Durnholde.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_002.source_old: You are right, Utok, and the carnage would do well in covering our escape. See it done!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S006_002.source_new: You are right, Utok, and the carnage would do well in covering our escape. See it done!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_001.source_old: Thank you strangers, I owe you my life.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_001.source_new: Thank you strangers, I owe you my life.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_002.source_old: Greetings Zul’jin, I am Rend Blackhand of the Orcish Horde. We have come to deliver you to safety.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_002.source_new: Greetings Zul’jin, I am Rend Blackhand of the Orcish Horde. We have come to deliver you to safety.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_003.source_old: Then we be truly in your debt, Rend Blackhand. Da shortest path to our village leads through da swamp.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_003.source_new: Then we be truly in your debt, Rend Blackhand. Da shortest path to our village leads through da swamp.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_004.source_old: Then we’d best get going. We will continue this conversation once you and your people are safe.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S007_004.source_new: Then we’d best get going. We will continue this conversation once you and your people are safe.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_001.source_old: Murlocs! I hate these two legged frog freaks… what are they doing here?
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_001.source_new: Murlocs! I hate these two legged frog freaks… what are they doing here?

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_002.source_old: It seems like the pests are a widespread plague on this world, Chieftain, much like Podlings back on Draenor.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_002.source_new: It seems like the pests are a widespread plague on this world, Chieftain, much like Podlings back on Draenor.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_003.source_old: I see… all the more reason to exterminate them!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S008_003.source_new: I see… all the more reason to exterminate them!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_001.source_old: Aargh, again with these slimy walking frogs! Must we mire ourselves with their blood everywhere?!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_001.source_new: Aargh, again with these slimy walking frogs! Must we mire ourselves with their blood everywhere?!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_002.source_old: They be a nuisance for everyone, friend. All races consider dem pests, even da elves and da humans, a rare matter dat we agree on.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S009_002.source_new: They be a nuisance for everyone, friend. All races consider dem pests, even da elves and da humans, a rare matter dat we agree on.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S010_001.source_old: The orcs are freeing the trolls! Stop them!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S010_001.source_new: The orcs are freeing the trolls! Stop them!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_001.source_old: It be Zul'jin! thank da loa! he's alive!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_001.source_new: It be Zul'jin! thank da loa! he's alive!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_002.source_old: Who be those green skins that accompany him?
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S011_002.source_new: Who be those green skins that accompany him?

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_001.source_old: Now dat we are safe, we can continue our conversation. On behalf of the Forest Trolls, I thank you for your help.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_001.source_new: Now dat we are safe, we can continue our conversation. On behalf of the Forest Trolls, I thank you for your help.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_002.source_old: Da Elves of Quel’thalas are our eternal enemies. In ancient times dey ravaged our empire with the help of da humans, and now history be repeating itself! Those mongrels were going to take me to Quel’thalas and put me in a cage for all the world to see!
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_002.source_new: Da Elves of Quel’thalas are our eternal enemies. In ancient times dey ravaged our empire with the help of da humans, and now history be repeating itself! Those mongrels were going to take me to Quel’thalas and put me in a cage for all the world to see!

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_003.source_old: You are a mighty warrior, Zul’jin! We will protect your people and bring ruin to all your enemies. In return you will provide us with your finest scouts and warriors.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_003.source_new: You are a mighty warrior, Zul’jin! We will protect your people and bring ruin to all your enemies. In return you will provide us with your finest scouts and warriors.

ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_005.source_old: It be good to be here, Rend Blackhand.
ToD_A01_M02_VO_S012_005.source_new: It be good to be here, Rend Blackhand.
